mostWorthwhile.text: The quiet receiving-lab scene is worthwhile: the second pair of hands and the silence make the discovery feel shared and consequential.

leastWorthwhile.text: The orbital view repeats familiar station details, though it gives the departure a sense of closure. There are no actions in this chapter to compare.

surprise.text: The ending's silence surprised me; it leaves the implications of the folded body open instead of explaining them.

arbitrary.text: No action felt arbitrary: there were no playable actions in this chapter.

continue.text: I would be curious to continue to see how the laboratory investigates the body, although this ending feels deliberately complete and offered no gameplay to judge.
